ModMetaData.name: Gizka Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces Mlie.StarWarsAnimalCollection's Gizka art with custom generated art per the 2026-09-11 owner ruling on `art: "improve"` rows: Star Wars-named creatures keep their canon identity, full regeneration, heavy black outline required.
The donor draws the adult stage from bodyGraphicData texPath swanimals/Gizka/Gizka, but 80% of wild spawns roll one of six recolored alternateGraphics entries on texPath swanimals/Gizka/GizkaW instead (alternateGraphicChance 0.8) - only one look was generated for this wave, so the SAME new art is wired to BOTH Gizka_<facing> and GizkaW_<facing> rather than leaving 80% of spawns on the old donor look. The dessicated-corpse texture (Gizka_Dessicated) stays on donor art. LABEL/ ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative paths the donor uses, so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
